name: TRDP Mario Milk Rusk
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (REFINED PALM OIL), SEMOLINA (WHEAT), YEAST, MILK SOLIDS (3%), INVERT SYRUP, MALT EXTRACT, IODIZED SALT, WHEAT FIBER, EMULS - IFIER (471, 472e & 481 (i)), ANTIOXIDANT (300) & FLOUR TREATMENT AGENTS 1100(i). CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR [NATURAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (MILK & VANILLA)].
